sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Preserve the prior interpolation-envelope and same-linked-hull-case repairs. The interpolation SPARQL constraint has accidental pass logic: its SELECT pattern matches a case that already contains all prescribed points, so compliant cases are reported as violations while incomplete cases may pass. Invert it with FILTER NOT EXISTS around the complete required-anchor/pairing pattern. Also explicitly constrain intermediate interpolation points/results to the declared piecewise-linear C_m relationship, rather than checking only the five anchor values. Finally, remove the guessed xsd:decimal datatype constraints unless a verified datatype declaration is supplied; the canonical metadata declares no datatype for these quantity properties.
